note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
Esau cried, “Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father.” Jacob had already received the major blessing. Rebekah sent him in, dressed in goats' hair so he would feel hairy like his brother, because she remembered what God told her at the birth: the elder shall serve the younger. When Jacob feared a curse, she said let it fall on her. The white man's the devil, and when you ask the Christians about those two boys, they say Jacob was the evil son and Esau the good one, and black people in church echo those same sentiments. No: Jacob was the good one. Esau was the profane one, the fornicator, the one who despised his birthright, and Rebekah was being obedient to God.

Isaac answered Esau: “thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above.” Dew falls everywhere, and wherever it falls, Esau would live; he would have the best places on the planet. How would he get them? “And by thy sword shalt thou live”: by war. God through Isaac blessed Esau with the art of war, the same blessing Cain's line had when Tubal-cain made all kinds of weapons.

Then: “and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.” When did that first happen? 2 Kings 8 answers. “Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign”, and “he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.” Yet the Lord would not destroy Judah for David's sake. “In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.” That is the first time Esau broke the yoke from off his neck, just as Genesis 27:40 prophesied.

After that, Edom turned on his brother outright. When the Babylonians destroyed the first temple in 586 BCE, Edom helped them instead of helping Judah: rejoicing, looting the city, blocking the survivors who fled. Obadiah, “concerning Edom”, says, “even thou wast as one of them”, and “Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape.” 1 Esdras names who set the fire: “the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldees.”

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

precepts.why:
Isaac told Esau, “And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother.” That goes right back to Cain being a fugitive and a vagabond: wandering all around, in lands that don't belong to him, acquiring them by the sword, killing and massacring and holding himself unaccountable. Some say they did not steal the Native Americans' land, they conquered it. What is the difference? After you conquered it, did you give it back? You kept it and gave it to your children, and then gave land to the Irish and British who came afterward and conquered nothing. That is stealing.

“and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck”: once David's lineage went off, Esau broke free of our rule and began to conquer. “And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing,” and said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” What did Cain do to Abel? He slew him. Nothing new under the sun: the same people doing the same exact thing. Rebekah told Jacob, “thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee”: how evil, to find comfort in killing your own brother.

Wisdom tells what became of Cain: “But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury wherewith he murdered his brother.” The unrighteous is Cain. When he killed Abel it was not a tap on the back of the head; he brutally killed him in his fury. And Cain was killed too, the same violent way he killed Abel.

That is why Rebekah said, “why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?” She knew: if Esau killed Jacob, God would kill Esau. You kill your brother, and you are going to die too.

note.label: Bitterness: The Hidden Leaven From Cain To Esau

precepts.why:
“And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” That is the bitterness, and it plans over a process of time. It is the same thing we read in Genesis 4: Cain slew Abel, and Esau wanted to kill Jacob. Cain was the firstborn and Esau was the firstborn. Same spirit.

To see how someone can hold bitterness, hatred and malice toward you and hide it completely, look at Genesis 33, long after Esau said he hated his brother: “And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.” Someone who hates you can play the long game. He can pretend to be your friend and on your side while he waits for the moment to hit you at your worst. They call them liberals today. That's the liberal for you: oh, we love you niggers, I mean black people. Jacob knew Esau's heart. That is why he sent the gifts ahead: he thought Esau might be coming to kill him.

Hebrews explains what was working in Esau: “Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled”. Looking diligently means looking within yourself. The root of bitterness is a hidden sin under the ground that nobody sees, but over time it springs up and troubles you. It distorts your thoughts and your perception, so that things you once saw clearly, with eyes anointed with eye salve, are no longer pure to you.

“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.” Profane means devoted to what is not sacred, secular rather than religious: Esau was a carnal man, a man of the field, whose religion is sin. When we follow the carnal ways of Esau, we throw away our birthright, the kingdom of heaven. Hebrews says “for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.” Hold on to a bitter spirit and you are a spiritual Edomite, and you will find the same place of no repentance on that day.

An officer drew the parallel: “He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning.” Christ came “that he might destroy the works of the devil”, so we cannot move in the devil's spirit and think we move in Christ's. Whoever does not love his brother is not of God. If there is an offense, deal with it by Matthew 18:15, not by sowing discord in the congregation. “For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.” The spiritually minded man seeks to gain his brother, not keep him as a rival to get back at, “Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God”.

note.label: Bitterness: The Hidden Leaven From Cain To Esau

precepts.why:
Esau cried, “Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing.” Is that true? Go back to Genesis 25. Esau came from the field faint and said, “Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage”. “And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.” There was no trickery. Jacob asked him straight, and it was up to Esau to say no. Esau said, “what profit shall this birthright do to me?” Jacob made him swear, because the word of that man is no good, just as with the four hundred and some treaties they broke. Scripture sums it up: “thus Esau despised his birthright.”

So Esau was lying and playing the victim. The Psalm describes it: “Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.” “Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.” Did we not just read the slander? He tricked me two times. Nowhere does scripture show Jacob dealing with deceit over the birthright. They were liars from the beginning, because they moved in the same spirit as their father Cain, who was of the wicked one.

It is how they do today: throw the rock, hide the hand, and as soon as the other side hits back, run to the UN as the victim. Now all of a sudden he cares about the birthright, just as his children want to stand in our place claiming to be the Jews and the people of the book. Where was that energy when he threw it away for something to eat, or today for money and fame?

You got the children of God and you got the children of the devil; there is no in between. You either got the godly mind or the Edomite mind. The same Psalm says to the wicked, the white man, “What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” “Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.” They say in God we trust and swear on the Bible while doing nothing the scripture says.

Esau “lifted up his voice, and wept”, but that was worldly sorrow. “For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.” We must come to the Lord sincerely, because of those who wait, God says, “Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:” “For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord”. “Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way”. We all have to examine ourselves so we are not moving in that same spirit.

note.label: I Come In Peace

precepts.why:
Isaac told Esau, “Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants.” Jacob was made Esau’s lord; the elder would serve the younger. Everybody on this planet was meant to be our servants. It is our birthright; we are the rulers of this earth. But the only way to get it back is to remember where we fell off and what we did wrong, and Christianity will not teach us that. It keeps us in the wrong, and keeps us divided into Adventist, Protestant, Pentecostal, Mormon and Jehovah’s Witness, with none of them telling us who we are.

Esau “lifted up his voice, and wept,” and he still got a blessing: “thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above.” The best portions of the earth, and the dew that falls on the whole earth. But the whole earth was already given to Jacob. How the hell is Esau going to get the best part of the earth? The next words answer it: “by thy sword shalt thou live.” He would take it by the sword. He is a killer, yet wherever he goes he says he comes in peace, that he only wants to liberate the people and bring them freedom, while it is missiles after missiles, rape after rape, nothing but atrocities once he is let in. That's what democracy is about: now you could be a homo, nobody can judge you; now you could be a transgender, nobody can judge you. The book of Maccabees shows evil multiplying on the earth when they took control.

The blessing ends, “and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.” 2 Kings 8:20 shows that yoke breaking: “In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.” Edom had served Judah, and in the days of the kings he threw it off.

From there it went back and forth. There was dominion again in 193 AD under Septimius Severus, wicked as hell as it was, and it was lost again around the Renaissance. So Isaac’s words have come to pass: Esau has possession of the earth, and he killed to get it.

His dominion is the pale horse: “his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. The fourth part of the world is America, as their own book on the birth of America calls it, which is why they call this hemisphere theirs, the Monroe Doctrine become the Donroe Doctrine. With hunger: Cuba starved out by cut-off oil and sanctions. With the beasts of the earth: zoonosis, mixing animal DNA. And no amount of money can hide the man of sin; he is being revealed, “that he might be revealed in his time.” The devil must be revealed in his time, through the words of the prophets and through us teaching his laws.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”. He worked metal, and at that time metal meant tools of war; he was not making decorations for your house. The mark followed Cain’s lineage: sin, violence and hatred were in his spirit. Where an artist sees art in raw material, his mind saw weapons. Weaponry came into the earth, or at least advanced, through Cain’s line. Murder led to industry, hatred led to technology, and violence led to institutional power, the hegemony that controls everything.

Then that spirit comes through Esau. “Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.” Isaac answered, “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above”: he would have rulership and authority. And the connection to Tubal-cain: “And by thy sword shalt thou live”. The fatness of the earth, everything he has, he gets by violence.

Then: “and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck”. That happened once our kingdom passed. We had a kingdom for a little while, and since then we have never been in any kind of power up to this day, while he increased through the process of time.

We see it in the graphic of Trump straddling the Western Hemisphere, the Monroe Doctrine renamed the Donroe Doctrine: this is mine. That is the one that sits upon many waters. The wicked are revealed, restrained for a time with a hedge around them to fulfill what the Lord wants, and then comes their final judgment.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
Lamech told his wives, “I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.” That was cold-blooded murder, killing with no anger behind it, for the thrill of it. Cain killed in anger; if he is judged, how much more Lamech, who just had violence in him. He boasted in it. It went beyond Cain; it increased. That is when murder was normalized and celebrated in that line.

That is why Esau has the same spirit: “And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” It is in his spirit till this day. Rebekah was told, “Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.” Killing is a comfort to him. Trump boasted that the Venezuela raid was very violent, and said of the boats, we are just going to kill them.

“Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran”. The only thing Jacob could do was flee; he could not stand against that bloodthirsty violence. It is the same spirit as Cain: patient, vengeful and calculated. Cain lured his brother into the field; Esau said, I will wait until the days of mourning are done, and get him when he least suspects it.

That spirit is the son of perdition. “Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition; Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God”. It says revealed, not elected: he was ordained from the beginning. Ezra was told, “Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau. For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” People blame Jacob for grabbing the heel, but none of them had done good or evil in the womb; it was a sign, and Jacob was always supposed to be in rulership. Christ said, “those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.” He is not kept; he is ordained for destruction.

The Lord “shall destroy with the brightness of his coming” him “whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders”: the bomb, the weapons, the industrial complex and the economics. So it runs like a ring: Cain murdered his brother Abel, his line built weapons, Esau plotted to murder his brother Jacob, Isaiah 14 reveals the oppressor of the nations, and 2 Thessalonians shows the man of sin fully manifested in these last days. The spirit did not disappear; it evolved from individual murder, to weapon maker, to institutional violence, to global domination, a man who says nothing can stop him but his own morality. But “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet” once he is laid down.

note.label: War of the Gods

precepts.why:
Zillah bare “Tubal–cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: Tubal-cain designed weaponry. Then Lamech, of the same line, boasts to his wives: “I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.” Anyone who tries to avenge himself on Lamech, he will rain hellfire on them. That line through Cain is the lineage that comes back again as Esau, and it was given the art of weaponry.

So Isaac’s word over Esau fits: “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above; And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother”. By his weaponry he lives. He was to serve his brother, but his skill with the sword would be so great that “when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.” He breaks the yoke his brother had over him.

And the principalities, the powers, the thrones he rules through were all created by Christ. Edom’s might comes from the one who made him.

That is the war we are in. Isaiah 14 calls him Lucifer and the king of Babylon: “how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” He weakens the nations through war, and “smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”, mostly God’s people. We have watched it: a whole country’s defense taken down and its president taken out in thirty minutes, jets shot out of the sky in ninety-three seconds, sonic weapons that left soldiers bleeding without a bullet fired, as in Panama in the eighties, and DARPA always twenty years ahead. They changed the Department of Defense back to the Department of War, because they know a name matters, as we should know the name of Israel matters.

Our people see that power and think he must be God, or that God must be with him. That is the great war of ignorance. Revelation 13 asks what the world asks: “Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” But his pride has deceived him: “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.” He will fall, and when these devils fall, “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.”

note.label: Genesis 27: The Blessing of Jacob

Paul names him: “any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright. For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.”

He that despised the birthright for one morsel of meat was rejected when he would have inherited the blessing. The tears in Genesis 27 are the tears in Hebrews 12, and they found no place of repentance.
